            transform: scale(0.97);
        }

        .tab-btn.active {
            color: var(--text-main);
            font-weight: 700;
            background: var(--tab-active-bg);
            box-shadow: 0 3px 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08);
            border: var(--module-border);
        }

        .tab-panel {
            display: none;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(16px, 4cqw, 22px);
            animation: fadeIn 0.4s ease;
        }

        .tab-panel.active {
            display: flex;
        }

        @keyframes fadeIn {
            from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(5px); }
            to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
        }

        /* 模块卡片化设计 */
        .module {
            display: none;
            background: var(--module-bg);
            border: var(--module-border);
            box-shadow: var(--module-shadow);
            border-radius: 14px;
            padding: clamp(14px, 3.5cqw, 20px);
            transition: all var(--transition-base);
        }

        .module.visible {
            display: block;
        }

        .module-label-row {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            margin-bottom: 14px;
        }

        .module-label-row::before {
            content: '';
            flex: 1;
            height: 1px;
            background: linear-gradient(270deg, var(--border-line), transparent);
            margin-right: 12px;
        }

        .module-label-row::after {
            content: '';
            flex: 1;
            height: 1px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--border-line), transparent);
            margin-left: 12px;
        }

        .module-label {
            display: inline-block;
            font-family: var(--font-en);
            font-size: clamp(0.85rem, 2.5cqw, 1rem);
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--label-color);
            padding: 3px 16px;
            border-radius: 999px;
            letter-spacing: 0.14em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
        }

        .scene .module-label {
            background: var(--label-bg-scene);
        }

        .plot .module-label,
        .relation .module-label {
            background: var(--label-bg-plot);
        }

        /* 模块正文 */
        .module-content {
            font-size: clamp(0.88rem, 2.6cqw, 0.98rem);
            font-weight: 600;
            line-height: 1.85;
            color: var(--text-main);
            text-align: justify;
            word-break: break-word;
        }

        .scene .module-content {
            text-align: center;
            font-weight: 600;
            font-size: clamp(0.92rem, 2.8cqw, 1.04rem);
            letter-spacing: 0.04em;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 10px;
        }

        .scene .module-content p {
            margin: 0 auto;
            padding: 8px 18px;
            background: var(--seeds-details-bg);
            border: var(--seeds-details-border);
            border-radius: 10px;
            width: fit-content;
            max-width: 100%;
        }

        .plot .module-content {
            letter-spacing: 0.02em;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 12px;
        }

        .plot .module-content p {
            margin: 0;
            text-indent: 2em;
        }

        .plot .module-content p:first-child {
            text-indent: 0;
        }

        .plot .module-content p:first-child::first-letter {
            float: left;
            font-size: 2.6em;
            color: var(--text-accent);
            line-height: 1;
            padding-right: 8px;
            font-family: var(--font-main);
            font-weight: 700;
            text-shadow: 0 2px 8px var(--accent-soft);
        }

        /* Relation 羁绊人物卡 */
        .relation-content {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 12px;
        }

        .char-card {
            background: var(--seeds-details-bg);
            border: var(--seeds-details-border);
            border-left: 3px solid var(--text-accent);
            padding: 12px 16px;
            border-radius: 4px 12px 12px 4px;
            transition: all var(--transition-base);
        }

        .char-card:hover {
            background: var(--accent-soft);
            transform: translateX(3px);
        }

        .char-head {
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--text-main);
            font-size: clamp(0.92rem, 2.7cqw, 1rem);
            padding-bottom: 4px;
        }

        .char-body {
            font-size: clamp(0.82rem, 2.4cqw, 0.9rem);
            color: var(--text-sub);
            line-height: 1.6;
        }

        /* Details 隐秘折叠框 (融合水母/枯蝶的箭头与图标变量) */
        .details-box {
            display: none;
            border: var(--seeds-details-border);
            border-radius: 12px;
            background: var(--seeds-details-bg);
            box-shadow: var(--module-shadow);
            overflow: hidden;
            transition: all var(--transition-base);
        }

        .details-box.visible {
            display: block;
        }

        .details-box:hover {
            border-color: var(--text-accent);
        }

        .details-box summary {
            list-style: none;
            padding: 12px 16px;
            font-weight: 600;
            font-size: clamp(0.86rem, 2.5cqw, 0.94rem);
            cursor: pointer;
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            color: var(--text-main);
            transition: all var(--transition-base);
            letter-spacing: 0.05em;
        }

        .details-box summary i {
            width: 24px;
            text-align: center;
            color: var(--seeds-content-icon-color);
        }

        .details-box summary::-webkit-details-marker {
            display: none;
        }

        .details-box summary::after {
            content: var(--seeds-summary-arrow);
            font-size: 0.78rem;
            transition: transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.8, 0.25, 1);
            color: var(--seeds-summary-arrow-color);
        }

        .details-box[open] summary {
            background: var(--accent-soft);
        }

        .details-box[open] summary::after {
            transform: rotate(180deg);
        }

        .details-content {
            padding: 14px 16px;
            font-size: clamp(0.84rem, 2.4cqw, 0.92rem);
            line-height: 1.65;
            border-top: var(--seeds-details-border);
            color: var(--text-main);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 6px;
        }

        .details-content .title {
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--text-main);
            padding-top: 4px;
            display: block;
        }

        .details-content .item {
            display: block;
            position: relative;
            padding-left: 18px;
            color: var(--text-sub);
        }

        .details-content .item::before {
            content: var(--seeds-content-icon);
            position: absolute;
            left: 2px;
            font-weight: bold;
            color: var(--seeds-content-icon-color);
        }

        /* Footer 底部工具栏与铭文 */
        .meow-footer {
            text-align: center;
            padding: clamp(16px, 4cqw, 22px) clamp(15px, 4cqw, 20px) clamp(22px, 5cqw, 30px);
            position: relative;
            z-index: 2;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 14px;
        }

        .meow-footer::before {
            content: '';
            display: block;
            width: 65%;
            height: 1px;
            background: var(--footer-border);
        }

        .footer-emblem {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 6px;
        }

        .footer-emblem.hidden {
            display: none;
        }

        .footer-divider-line {
            font-size: 0.88rem;
            color: var(--text-accent);
            opacity: 0.85;
        }

        .footer-text {
            margin: 0;
            font-size: clamp(1rem, 3cqw, 1.15rem);
            font-family: var(--font-en);
            color: var(--text-main);
            letter-spacing: 0.06em;
            text-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--accent-soft);
        }

        /* 胶囊工具栏 */
        .theme-capsule {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            border: var(--module-border);
            border-radius: 50px;
            padding: 4px;
            gap: 4px;
            background: var(--capsule-bg);
            transition: all var(--transition-base);
            backdrop-filter: blur(6px);
        }

        .theme-capsule:hover {
            border-color: var(--text-accent);
        }

        .capsule-btn {
            cursor: pointer;
            font-size: 0.95rem;
            color: var(--text-sub);
            width: 36px;
            height: 30px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            border-radius: 20px;
            transition: all var(--transition-base);
        }

        .capsule-btn:hover {
            color: var(--text-main);
            background: var(--accent-soft);
        }

        .capsule-btn:active {
            transform: scale(0.92);
        }

        .capsule-btn.active {
            color: var(--text-accent);
            text-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--accent-soft);
            transform: scale(1.05);
        }

        .capsule-btn.inactive-manual {
            opacity: 0.6;
        }

        .capsule-divider {
            width: 1px;
            height: 14px;
            background-color: var(--border-line);
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>

    <div class="raw-data">$1</div>

    <div class="meow-fm-container">
        <canvas id="particle-canvas"></canvas>

        <div class="relative-content">
            <header class="header-area" id="toggle-header">
                <div class="serial-row">
                    <span class="serial-decorator left">𐙚</span>
                    <div class="serial">Loading...</div>
                    <span class="serial-decorator right">𐙚</span>
                </div>
                <div class="meta-row">
                    <div class="time"></div>
                    <div class="nsfw-tag"></div>
                </div>
                <button class="expand-button" id="expand-btn-text" type="button">
                    <i class="fa-solid fa-water"></i>
                    <span>触碰水母泡沫</span>
                </button>
            </header>

            <div class="meow-collapsible" id="collapsible-content">
                <div class="content-wrapper">
                    <div class="inner-padding">
                        
                        <div class="tabs-area" id="tabsArea">
                            <button class="tab-btn active" data-target="panel-main" id="tab-main" type="button">✧ 溯源</button>
                            <button class="tab-btn" data-target="panel-relation" id="tab-relation" type="button">✦ 羁绊</button>
                            <button class="tab-btn" data-target="panel-secret" id="tab-secret" type="button">✣ 隐秘</button>
                        </div>
                        
                        <div class="tab-content-wrapper">
                            <!-- 溯源 (Scene/Plot) -->
                            <div class="tab-panel active" id="panel-main">
                                <div class="module scene" id="mod-scene">
                                    <div class="module-label-row">
                                        <span class="module-label">Scenario</span>
                                    </div>
                                    <div class="module-content scene-content"></div>
                                </div>
                                <div class="module plot" id="mod-plot">
                                    <div class="module-label-row">
                                        <span class="module-label">Plot</span>
                                    </div>
                                    <div class="module-content plot-content"></div>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                            
                            <!-- 羁绊 (Relation) -->
                            <div class="tab-panel" id="panel-relation">
                                <div class="module relation" id="mod-relation">
                                    <div class="module-label-row">
                                        <span class="module-label">Relation</span>
                                    </div>
                                    <div class="module-content relation-content"></div>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                            
                            <!-- 隐秘 (Details) -->
                            <div class="tab-panel" id="panel-secret">
                                <details class="details-box" id="mod-nsfw">
                                    <summary><span><i class="fa-solid fa-feather-pointed"></i> 绮念沉沦</span></summary>
                                    <div class="details-content nsfw-content"></div>
                                </details>
                                <details class="details-box" id="mod-archived">
                                    <summary><span><i class="fa-solid fa-box-archive"></i> 封存回响</span></summary>
                                    <div class="details-content archived-content"></div>
                                </details>
                                <details class="details-box" id="mod-enigma">
                                    <summary><span><i class="fa-solid fa-file-shield"></i> 绝密档案</span></summary>
                                    <div class="details-content enigma-content"></div>
                                </details>
                                <details class="details-box" id="mod-seeds">
                                    <summary><span><i class="fa-solid fa-seedling"></i> 未来种子</span></summary>
                                    <div class="details-content seeds-content"></div>
                                </details>
                            </div>
                        </div>

                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>

            <footer class="meow-footer">
                <div class="theme-capsule">
                    <div class="capsule-btn active" id="autoBtn" title="自动跟随时间 (6:00-18:00 水母日间)">
                        <i class="fa-solid fa-infinity"></i>
                    </div>
                    <div class="capsule-divider"></div>
                    <div class="capsule-btn" id="themeToggleBtn" title="切换水母/枯蝶模式">
                        <span id="themeIcon"><i class="fa-solid fa-sun"></i></span>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <div class="footer-emblem footer-light">
                    <span class="footer-divider-line">· ─────── 🪼 ─────── ·</span>
                    <p class="footer-text">𝒜𝓊𝓇ℯ𝓁𝒾𝒶 · 𝒟𝓇ℯ𝒶𝓂𝓎 𝒥ℯ𝓁𝓁𝓎𝒻𝒾𝓈𝒽</p>
                </div>
                <div class="footer-emblem footer-dark hidden">
                    <span class="footer-divider-line">· ─────── 🦋 ─────── ·</span>
                    <p class="footer-text">𝕻𝖆𝖕𝖎𝖑𝖎𝖔 · 𝖂𝖎𝖙𝖍𝖊𝖗𝖊𝖉 𝕭𝖚𝖙𝖙𝖊𝖗𝖋𝖑𝖞</p>
                </div>
            </footer>
        </div>
    </div>

    <script>
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
            // ================= 1. 粒子系统 =================
            const canvas = document.getElementById('particle-canvas');
            const container = document.querySelector('.meow-fm-container');
            const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
            let particles = [];
            let width, height;

            function resizeCanvas() {
                width = container.offsetWidth;
                height = container.offsetHeight;
                canvas.width = width;
                canvas.height = height;
            }
            new ResizeObserver(resizeCanvas).observe(container);
            resizeCanvas();

            class Particle {
                constructor() { this.reset(true); }
                reset(initial = false) {
                    this.x = Math.random() * width;
                    this.y = initial ? Math.random() * height : height + 5;
                    this.size = Math.random() * 2.2 + 0.6;
                    this.speedY = Math.random() * 0.35 + 0.1;
                    this.speedX = Math.random() * 0.4 - 0.2;
                    this.opacity = Math.random() * 0.5 + 0.15;
                    this.fadeSpeed = Math.random() * 0.005 + 0.002;
                    this.fadingOut = Math.random() > 0.5;
                }
                update() {
                    this.y -= this.speedY;
                    this.x += this.speedX;
                    if (this.fadingOut) {
                        this.opacity -= this.fadeSpeed;
                        if (this.opacity <= 0.05) this.fadingOut = false;
                    } else {
                        this.opacity += this.fadeSpeed;
                        if (this.opacity >= 0.65) this.fadingOut = true;
                    }
                    if (this.y < -10 || this.x < -10 || this.x > width + 10) this.reset();
                }
                draw() {
                    const style = getComputedStyle(document.body);
                    const colorStr = style.getPropertyValue('--particle-color').trim();
                    ctx.fillStyle = colorStr;
                    ctx.globalAlpha = this.opacity;
                    ctx.beginPath();
                    ctx.arc(this.x, this.y, this.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                    ctx.fill();
                    ctx.globalAlpha = 1.0;
                }
            }

            function initParticles() {
                particles = [];
                const count = Math.max(15, Math.floor(container.offsetWidth / 8));
                for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) particles.push(new Particle());
            }
            function animateParticles() {
                ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
                particles.forEach(p => { p.update(); p.draw(); });
                requestAnimationFrame(animateParticles);
            }
            setTimeout(() => { resizeCanvas(); initParticles(); animateParticles(); }, 200);

            // ================= 2. 健壮的解析器 (适配双NSFW) =================
            function parseAndRender() {
                const rawDataElement = document.querySelector('.raw-data');
                const rawText = rawDataElement ? (rawDataElement.innerText || rawDataElement.textContent || "").trim() : "";
                if (!rawText) return;

                const keys = ['serial', 'time', 'nsfw', 'scene', 'plot', 'relation', 'archived', 'enigma', 'seeds'];
                const regex = new RegExp(`(${keys.join('|')})\\s*[:：]`, 'gi');
                const matches = [...rawText.matchAll(regex)];

                const data = {};
                for (let i = 0; i < matches.length; i++) {
                    const match = matches[i];
                    const key = match[1].toLowerCase();
                    const start = match.index + match[0].length;
                    const end = matches[i + 1] ? matches[i + 1].index : rawText.length;
                    const content = rawText.substring(start, end).trim();

                    if (key === 'nsfw') {
                        if (!content.includes('\n') && content.length < 40 && !data['nsfw_tag']) {
                            data['nsfw_tag'] = content;
                        } else {
                            data['nsfw_content'] = content;
                        }
                    } else {
                        data[key] = content;
                    }
                }

                if (data.serial) document.querySelector('.serial').textContent = data.serial;
                if (data.time) document.querySelector('.time').textContent = data.time;

                const nsfwTag = document.querySelector('.nsfw-tag');
                if (data.nsfw_tag && data.nsfw_tag !== '0' && data.nsfw_tag.toLowerCase() !== 'false') {
                    nsfwTag.textContent = "NSFW: " + data.nsfw_tag;
                    nsfwTag.classList.add('visible');
                } else {
                    nsfwTag.classList.remove('visible');
                }

                const sceneMod = document.getElementById('mod-scene');
                if (data.scene) {
                    sceneMod.classList.add('visible');
                    document.querySelector('.scene-content').innerHTML = data.scene
                        .split('\n')
                        .filter(l => l.trim())
                        .map(l => `<p>${l}</p>`)
                        .join('');
                } else {
                    sceneMod.classList.remove('visible');
                }

                const plotMod = document.getElementById('mod-plot');
                if (data.plot) {
                    plotMod.classList.add('visible');
                    document.querySelector('.plot-content').innerHTML = data.plot
                        .split('\n')
                        .filter(l => l.trim())
                        .map(l => `<p>${l}</p>`)
                        .join('');
                } else {
                    plotMod.classList.remove('visible');
                }

                const relationMod = document.getElementById('mod-relation');
                if (data.relation) {
                    relationMod.classList.add('visible');
                    const relContainer = document.querySelector('.relation-content');
                    relContainer.innerHTML = '';
                    const chunks = data.relation.split('◈');
                    chunks.forEach(chunk => {
                        if (!chunk.trim()) return;
                        const lines = chunk.trim().split('\n');
                        if (lines.length > 0) {
                            const card = document.createElement('div');
                            card.className = 'char-card';
                            const head = lines[0].trim();
                            const body = lines.slice(1).join('<br>');
                            card.innerHTML = `<div class="char-head">${head}</div><div class="char-body">${body}</div>`;
                            relContainer.appendChild(card);
                        }
                    });
                } else {
                    relationMod.classList.remove('visible');
                }

                const renderDetails = (key, dataKey) => {
                    const mod = document.getElementById(`mod-${key}`);
                    const content = data[dataKey];
                    if (content) {
                        mod.classList.add('visible');
                        const detailContainer = mod.querySelector(`.${key}-content`);
                        detailContainer.innerHTML = '';
                        content.split('\n').forEach(line => {
                            const text = line.trim();
                            if (!text) return;
                            const p = document.createElement('div');
                            if (text.startsWith('-') || text.startsWith('•')) {
                                p.className = 'item';
                                p.textContent = text.substring(1).trim();
                            } else {
                                p.className = 'title';
                                p.textContent = text;
                            }
                            detailContainer.appendChild(p);
                        });
                    } else {
                        mod.classList.remove('visible');
                    }
                };

                renderDetails('nsfw', 'nsfw_content');
                renderDetails('archived', 'archived');
                renderDetails('enigma', 'enigma');
                renderDetails('seeds', 'seeds');

                const hasMain = Boolean(data.scene || data.plot);
                const hasRelation = Boolean(data.relation);
                const hasSecret = Boolean(data.nsfw_content || data.archived || data.enigma || data.seeds);

                const tabMain = document.getElementById('tab-main');
                const tabRelation = document.getElementById('tab-relation');
                const tabSecret = document.getElementById('tab-secret');
                const tabsArea = document.getElementById('tabsArea');

                if (hasMain || hasRelation || hasSecret) {
                    tabsArea.classList.add('visible');
                    tabMain.classList.toggle('hidden', !hasMain);
                    tabRelation.classList.toggle('hidden', !hasRelation);
                    tabSecret.classList.toggle('hidden', !hasSecret);

                    if (hasMain) tabMain.click();
                    else if (hasRelation) tabRelation.click();
                    else if (hasSecret) tabSecret.click();
                } else {
                    tabsArea.classList.remove('visible');
                }
            }

            // ================= 3. UI 交互与主题控制 =================
            const header = document.getElementById('toggle-header');
            const collapsibleContent = document.getElementById('collapsible-content');
            const buttonText = document.querySelector('#expand-btn-text span');
            const buttonIcon = document.querySelector('#expand-btn-text i');

            const autoBtn = document.getElementById('autoBtn');
            const themeBtn = document.getElementById('themeToggleBtn');
            const themeIcon = document.getElementById('themeIcon');
            const footerLight = document.querySelector('.footer-light');
            const footerDark = document.querySelector('.footer-dark');
            const body = document.body;

            const KEY_MODE = 'jelly_butterfly_summary_mode';
            const KEY_THEME = 'jelly_butterfly_summary_theme';

            let isAutoMode = localStorage.getItem(KEY_MODE) !== 'manual';
            let isDarkMode = localStorage.getItem(KEY_THEME) === 'dark';

            function syncExpandButtonText() {
                const isOpen = collapsibleContent.classList.contains('open');
                if (isDarkMode) {
                    buttonText.textContent = isOpen ? '敛起枯蝶残翼' : '掀开标本匣';
                    buttonIcon.className = isOpen ? 'fa-solid fa-eye-slash' : 'fa-solid fa-butterfly';
                    if (buttonIcon.className.includes('fa-butterfly')) {
                        buttonIcon.className = 'fa-solid fa-feather';
                    }
                } else {
                    buttonText.textContent = isOpen ? '潜入深海微光' : '触碰水母泡沫';
                    buttonIcon.className = isOpen ? 'fa-solid fa-droplet' : 'fa-solid fa-water';
                }
            }

            document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn').forEach(tab => {
                tab.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                    e.stopPropagation();
                    document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn').forEach(btn => btn.classList.remove('active'));
                    document.querySelectorAll('.tab-panel').forEach(panel => panel.classList.remove('active'));
                    
                    tab.classList.add('active');
                    const targetId = tab.getAttribute('data-target');
                    const targetPanel = document.getElementById(targetId);
                    if (targetPanel) targetPanel.classList.add('active');
                });
            });

            header.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                if (e.target.closest('.meow-footer') || e.target.closest('.theme-capsule')) return;
                collapsibleContent.classList.toggle('open');
                syncExpandButtonText();
            });

            document.querySelectorAll('.details-box').forEach(el => {
                el.addEventListener('click', (event) => event.stopPropagation());
            });

            function updateThemeUI() {
                if (isAutoMode) {
                    autoBtn.classList.add('active');
                    themeBtn.classList.add('inactive-manual');
                } else {
                    autoBtn.classList.remove('active');
                    themeBtn.classList.remove('inactive-manual');
                }

                    ? '<i class="fa-solid fa-moon"></i>'
                    : '<i class="fa-solid fa-sun"></i>';

                if (isDarkMode) {
                    body.classList.add('dark-mode');
                    footerLight.classList.add('hidden');
                    footerDark.classList.remove('hidden');
                } else {
                    body.classList.remove('dark-mode');
                    footerLight.classList.remove('hidden');
                    footerDark.classList.add('hidden');
                }
                syncExpandButtonText();
            }

            function checkTime() {
                if (!isAutoMode) return;
                const hour = new Date().getHours();
                const isDayTime = hour >= 6 && hour < 18;
                isDarkMode = !isDayTime;
                updateThemeUI();
            }

            if (isAutoMode) {
                checkTime();
            } else {
                updateThemeUI();
            }
            setInterval(checkTime, 60000);

            autoBtn.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
                e.stopPropagation();
                isAutoMode = true;
                localStorage.setItem(KEY_MODE, 'auto');
                checkTime();
                updateThemeUI();
            });

            themeBtn.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
                e.stopPropagation();
                isAutoMode = false;
                localStorage.setItem(KEY_MODE, 'manual');
                isDarkMode = !isDarkMode;
                localStorage.setItem(KEY_THEME, isDarkMode ? 'dark' : 'light');
                updateThemeUI();
            });

            parseAndRender();

        }

        .confirm-btn:hover {
            transform: translateY(-1px);
            filter: brightness(1.05);
        }

        .confirm-btn:active {
            transform: scale(0.96);
        }

        /* 轻提示气泡 */
        .toast-box {
            position: fixed;
            top: 50%;
            left: 50%;
            transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
            background: var(--toast-bg);
            backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
            border: var(--expand-btn-border);
            color: var(--toast-text);
            padding: 10px 22px;
            border-radius: 30px;
            font-size: 13px;
            pointer-events: none;
            opacity: 0;
            z-index: 999;
            white-space: nowrap;
            letter-spacing: 1px;
            box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25);
        }

        .toast-box.show {
            animation: anime-fade-in-out 1.8s forwards;
        }

        @keyframes anime-enter {
            from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(12px); }
            to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
        }

        @keyframes anime-slide-in {
            from { opacity: 0; transform: translateX(10px); }
            to { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(0); }
        }

        @keyframes anime-fade-in-out {
            0% { opacity: 0; transform: translate(-50%, -40%); }
            15% { opacity: 1; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); }
            85% { opacity: 1; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); }
            100% { opacity: 0; transform: translate(-50%, -60%); }
        }

        @keyframes slideUp {
            from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(8px); }
            to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <div id="th-raw-data">$1</div>
    <div id="app">
        <div id="mainPanel" class="container">
            <div id="header-toggle" class="header">
                <div class="title-row">
                    <span class="title-decorator">.⊹ 𐙚┈</span>
                    <p class="title-custom">日月西抉选</p>
                    <span class="title-decorator">┈𐙚 ⊹.</span>
                </div>
                <div class="subtitle" id="themeSubtitle">M O O N × S U N</div>
                <div class="collapse-btn"><i class="fa-solid fa-chevron-down"></i></div>
            </div>

            <div class="collapsible-content">
                <div class="collapsible-inner">
                    <div id="tabsArea" class="tabs-area">
                        <button class="tab-btn active" data-target="optionsList" type="button">选项分支</button>
                        <button id="tabPlans" class="tab-btn hidden" data-target="plansList" type="button">待办日程</button>
                        <button id="tabIdeas" class="tab-btn hidden" data-target="ideasList" type="button">活动灵感</button>
                        <button id="tabEvents" class="tab-btn hidden" data-target="eventsList" type="button">平行事件</button>
                    </div>

                    <div class="lists-wrapper">
                        <div id="optionsList" class="list-area active">
                            <div class="empty-hint">Waiting for Jellyfish Foam...</div>
                        </div>
                        <div id="plansList" class="list-area"></div>
                        <div id="ideasList" class="list-area"></div>
                        <div id="eventsList" class="list-area"></div>
                    </div>

                    <div class="controls">
                        <div class="left-group">
                            <button id="btnAuto" class="tool-btn" type="button" title="6-18点水母亮色，其余枯蝶暗色">◐ 自动</button>
                            <button id="btnManual" class="tool-btn" type="button" title="切换水母/枯蝶模式">🪼 水母</button>
                            <button id="btnFontDown" class="tool-btn icon-only" type="button" title="缩小字体"><i class="fa-solid fa-minus"></i></button>
                            <button id="btnFontUp" class="tool-btn icon-only" type="button" title="放大字体"><i class="fa-solid fa-plus"></i></button>
                            <button id="btnRefresh" class="tool-btn icon-only" type="button" title="重置选项"><i class="fa-solid fa-rotate-right"></i></button>
                            <button id="btnClear" class="tool-btn icon-only" type="button" title="清空输入框"><i class="fa-solid fa-eraser"></i></button>
                        </div>
                        <button id="btnSubmit" class="confirm-btn" type="button">确认</button>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
        <div id="toast" class="toast-box"></div>
    </div>

    <script>
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            const KEY_FONT = 'jelly_butterfly_font_size';
            const KEY_THEME = 'jelly_butterfly_theme_pref';
            const KEY_MODE = 'jelly_butterfly_mode_pref';
            const KEY_COLLAPSE = 'jelly_butterfly_collapse_state';

            const REGEX_TODO = /\n?\s*◈\s*TODO\s*(?:\||·)/;
            const REGEX_ACT = /\n?\s*◈\s*(?:ACTIVITY|IDEA)\s*(?:\||·)/i;
            const REGEX_PAR = /\n?\s*◈\s*(?:PARALLEL|EVENT)\s*(?:\||·)/i;

            const state = {
                selected: new Set(),
                selectedPlans: new Set(),
                selectedActivities: new Set(),
                selectedParallels: new Set(),
                fontSize: 16,
                themeMode: 'auto',
                isDark: false,
                isCollapsed: false
            };

            const store = {
                plans: new Map(),
                activities: new Map(),
                parallels: new Map()
            };

            const optionsList = document.getElementById('optionsList');
            const mainPanel = document.getElementById('mainPanel');
            const btnSubmit = document.getElementById('btnSubmit');
            const btnAuto = document.getElementById('btnAuto');
            const btnManual = document.getElementById('btnManual');
            const toast = document.getElementById('toast');
            const headerToggle = document.getElementById('header-toggle');

            // 提取元信息字段
            function extractMetaField(text, prefix, stopPattern) {
                if (!text) return '';
                const reg = new RegExp(`${prefix}\\s*([^\\n]+?)(?=\\s*,\\s*(?:${stopPattern})\\s*|$)`);
                const match = text.match(reg);
                return match ? match[1].trim() : '';
            }

            // 渲染元信息胶囊标签
            function renderChip(iconClass, content, extraClass = '') {
                return content ? `<span class="meta-chip ${extraClass}"><i class="fa-solid ${iconClass}"></i>${content}</span>` : '';
            }

            // 解析时间字符串为可排序时间戳
            function parseTimestamp(str) {
                const text = (str || '').trim();
                if (!text) return null;
                const now = new Date();
                const todayBase = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), now.getDate());

                const buildTime = (y, m, d, hr = 0, min = 0) => {
                    const dt = new Date(y, m - 1, d, hr, min, 0, 0);
                    return Number.isNaN(dt.getTime()) ? null : dt.getTime();
                };

                const normalizeHourMin = (hrStr, minStr, periodStr) => {
                    let hr = Number.parseInt(hrStr ?? '0', 10);
                    const min = Number.parseInt(minStr ?? '0', 10);
                    const period = periodStr ?? '';
                    if (Number.isNaN(hr) || Number.isNaN(min)) return { hour: 0, minute: 0 };
                    if (/(下午|晚上)/.test(period) && hr < 12) hr += 12;
                    if (/(凌晨)/.test(period) && hr === 12) hr = 0;
                    if (/(中午)/.test(period) && hr < 11) hr += 12;
                    if (/(上午|早上|清晨)/.test(period) && hr === 12) hr = 0;
                    return { hour: hr, minute: min };
                };

                const fullMatch = text.match(/(\d{4})[年/.-](\d{1,2})[月/.-](\d{1,2})[日\sT]*(?:(凌晨|早上|上午|中午|下午|晚上)?\s*(\d{1,2})(?:[:：时](\d{1,2}))?)?/);
                if (fullMatch) {
                    const y = Number.parseInt(fullMatch[1], 10);
                    const m = Number.parseInt(fullMatch[2], 10);
                    const d = Number.parseInt(fullMatch[3], 10);
                    const { hour, minute } = normalizeHourMin(fullMatch[5], fullMatch[6], fullMatch[4]);
                    return buildTime(y, m, d, hour, minute);
                }

                const mdMatch = text.match(/(\d{1,2})[月/.-](\d{1,2})[日\s]*(?:(凌晨|早上|上午|中午|下午|晚上)?\s*(\d{1,2})(?:[:：时](\d{1,2}))?)?/);
                if (mdMatch) {
                    const m = Number.parseInt(mdMatch[1], 10);
                    const d = Number.parseInt(mdMatch[2], 10);
                    const { hour, minute } = normalizeHourMin(mdMatch[4], mdMatch[5], mdMatch[3]);
                    return buildTime(now.getFullYear(), m, d, hour, minute);
                }

                const relMatch = text.match(/(前天|昨天|今天|明天|后天)(?:\s*(凌晨|早上|上午|中午|下午|晚上)?\s*(\d{1,2})(?:[:：时](\d{1,2}))?)?/);
                if (relMatch) {
                    const offset = { '前天': -2, '昨天': -1, '今天': 0, '明天': 1, '后天': 2 }[relMatch[1]] ?? 0;
                    const dt = new Date(todayBase);
                    dt.setDate(dt.getDate() + offset);
                    const { hour, minute } = normalizeHourMin(relMatch[3], relMatch[4], relMatch[2]);
                    dt.setHours(hour, minute, 0, 0);
                    return dt.getTime();
                }

                const hmMatch = text.match(/(凌晨|早上|上午|中午|下午|晚上)?\s*(\d{1,2})[:：时](\d{1,2})/);
                if (hmMatch) {
                    const { hour, minute } = normalizeHourMin(hmMatch[2], hmMatch[3], hmMatch[1]);
                    const dt = new Date(todayBase);
                    dt.setHours(hour, minute, 0, 0);
                    return dt.getTime();
                }
                return null;
            }

            function findFirstTimestamp(...candidates) {
                for (const c of candidates) {
                    if (!c) continue;
                    const ts = parseTimestamp(c);
                    if (ts !== null) return ts;
                }
                return null;
            }

            function sortCardsByTime(arr) {
                return arr.sort((a, b) => {
                    if (a.sortTime === null && b.sortTime === null) return a.originalIndex - b.originalIndex;
                    if (a.sortTime === null) return 1;
                    if (b.sortTime === null) return -1;
                    return (a.sortTime - b.sortTime) || (a.originalIndex - b.originalIndex);
                });
            }

            function sortSelectedItems(arr) {
                return [...arr].sort((a, b) => {
                    const ta = a.sortTime ?? null;
                    const tb = b.sortTime ?? null;
                    if (ta === null && tb === null) return 0;
                    if (ta === null) return 1;
                    if (tb === null) return -1;
                    return ta - tb;
                });
            }

            // 清理选项行首前缀
            function stripOptionPrefix(line) {
                let text = line.trim();
                const prefixReg = /^\s*(?:(?:\d+|[A-Za-z])[.、)\]）:：-]|[①②③④⑤⑥⑦⑧⑨⑩⑪⑫⑬⑭⑮⑯⑰⑱⑲⑳]|[一二三四五六七八九十]+[、.．)）]|[-*+•·▪▫◦‣⁃◈◆◇▶►▸▹▻☑☐✓✔✦✧❖※])\s*/;
                let prev = '';
                let count = 0;
                while (text && text !== prev && count < 4) {
                    prev = text;
                    text = text.replace(prefixReg, '').trimStart();
                    count += 1;
                }
                return text.trim();
            }

            function toggleCardSelection(category, id, cardEl) {
                const targetSet = category === 'plans'
                    ? state.selectedPlans
                    : category === 'activities'
                        ? state.selectedActivities
                        : state.selectedParallels;

                if (targetSet.has(id)) {
                    targetSet.delete(id);
                    cardEl.classList.remove('selected');
                } else {
                    targetSet.add(id);
                    cardEl.classList.add('selected');
                }
                updateConfirmButton();
            }

            // 构建结构化推进提示词
            function formatPromptBlock(category, items) {
                if (!items.length) return '';
                const label = category === 'plans' ? '待办日程' : category === 'activities' ? '活动灵感' : '平行事件';
                const cStart = '<' + '!--';
                const cEnd = '--' + '>';

                if (category === 'plans') {
                    const lines = items.map((item, idx) =>
                        `${idx + 1}. 请将剧情推进到${item.time || '未标注时间'}，在${item.location || '未标注地点'}围绕「${item.title || '未命名待办'}」这项${item.kind || '未标注类型'}日程展开，执行人是${item.roles || '未标注'}，核心推进内容为：${item.desc || '无'}`
                    ).join('\n');
                    return `${cStart} ${label}\n请按时间顺序推进以下已选待办，并自然衔接剧情：\n${lines}\n默认从第1项待办开始推进。\n${cEnd}`;
                }

                if (category === 'activities') {
                    const lines = items.map((item, idx) =>
                        `${idx + 1}. 请在${item.time || '未标注时间'}于${item.location || '未标注地点'}触发「${item.title || '未命名活动'}」这项${item.kind || '未标注类型'}活动（推荐评级：${item.rating || '未标注'}），参与角色为${item.roles || '未标注'}，互动推进要点是：${item.desc || '无'}`
                    ).join('\n');
                    return `${cStart} ${label}\n请结合下列活动灵感推进当前剧情，并保证衔接自然：\n${lines}\n优先从第1项活动切入正文。\n${cEnd}`;
                }

                const lines = items.map((item, idx) =>
                    `${idx + 1}. 当前别处在${item.time || '未标注时间'}、${item.location || '未标注地点'}发生「${item.title || '未命名平行事件'}」，涉及人物：${item.roles || '未标注'}；客观事件内容：${item.desc || '无'} 请仅作为世界同步信息影响主线，不要让主视角无理由直接得知。`
                ).join('\n');
                return `${cStart} ${label}\n请将以下平行事件作为世界状态同步背景，并与主线建立潜在关联：\n${lines}\n这些信息用于营造同时间多地点并行推进感。\n${cEnd}`;
            }

            // 解析并渲染全部标签页
            function parseAndRender() {
                const rawEl = document.getElementById('th-raw-data');
                const rawText = (rawEl?.textContent ?? '').trim();
                store.plans.clear();
                store.activities.clear();
                store.parallels.clear();

                const secRegex = new RegExp(`(?:^|\\n)(${['plans', 'activity', 'ideas', 'events', 'parallel'].join('|')})\\s*[:：]`, 'gi');
                const matches = [...rawText.matchAll(secRegex)];
                const sections = {};
                let optionsBlock = rawText;

                if (matches.length > 0) {
                    optionsBlock = rawText.substring(0, matches[0].index).trim();
                    for (let i = 0; i < matches.length; i += 1) {
                        const secName = matches[i][1].toLowerCase();
                        const start = matches[i].index + matches[i][0].length;
                        const end = i + 1 < matches.length ? matches[i + 1].index : rawText.length;
                        sections[secName] = rawText.substring(start, end).trim();
                    }
                }

                // 1. 渲染选项分支
                const optionLines = optionsBlock
                    .split('\n')
                    .map(stripOptionPrefix)
                    .filter(line => line && !line.toLowerCase().startsWith('options:'));

                optionsList.innerHTML = '';
                if (optionLines.length === 0) {
                    optionsList.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-hint">暂无可选项</div>';
                } else {
                    optionLines.forEach((optText, idx) => {
                        const btn = document.createElement('div');
                        btn.className = 'option-btn';
                        btn.textContent = optText;
                        btn.style.animationDelay = `${idx * 0.05}s`;
                        btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                            if (state.selected.has(optText)) {
                                state.selected.delete(optText);
                                btn.classList.remove('selected');
                            } else {
                                state.selected.add(optText);
                                btn.classList.add('selected');
                            }
                            updateConfirmButton();
                        });
                        optionsList.appendChild(btn);
                    });
                }

                let hasExtraTabs = false;

                // 2. 渲染待办日程
                const tabPlans = document.getElementById('tabPlans');
                const plansList = document.getElementById('plansList');
                if (sections.plans && sections.plans.trim() !== '') {
                    hasExtraTabs = true;
                    tabPlans.classList.remove('hidden');
                    plansList.innerHTML = '';

                    const parsedPlans = sections.plans
                        .split(REGEX_TODO)
                        .map((b, i) => ({ block: b.trim(), originalIndex: i }))
                        .filter(item => Boolean(item.block))
                        .map(item => {
                            const b = item.block;
                            const headMatch = b.match(/^(.*?)(?:<|＜)(.*?)(?:>|＞)/);
                            const title = headMatch ? headMatch[1].trim() : '未命名待办';
                            const bracket = headMatch ? headMatch[2].trim() : '私人日程';
                            let typeInfo = bracket;
                            let timeInfo = '';
                            const parts = bracket.split(/\s*(?:⌾|\|)\s*/);
                            if (parts.length > 1) {
                                typeInfo = parts[0];
                                timeInfo = parts[1];
                            }
                            const metaMatch = b.match(/[├┣]\s*[─-━]\s*(.*?)(?=\n|$)/);
                            const metaText = metaMatch ? metaMatch[1].trim() : '';
                            const descMatch = b.match(/[└┗]\s*[─-━]\s*(?:🎬|📝|📰)?\s*(.*)$/s);
                            const descText = descMatch ? descMatch[1].trim() : '';
                            return {
                                title,
                                typeInfo,
                                timeInfo,
                                metaText,
                                descText,
                                sortTime: findFirstTimestamp(timeInfo, metaText, descText, b),
                                originalIndex: item.originalIndex
                            };
                        });

                    sortCardsByTime(parsedPlans).forEach((item, idx) => {
                        const card = document.createElement('div');
                        const id = `plan-${idx}`;
                        card.className = 'plan-card';
                        card.style.animationDelay = `${idx * 0.05}s`;

                        const loc = extractMetaField(item.metaText, '📍', '📍|👥');
                        const roles = extractMetaField(item.metaText, '👥', '📍|👥');
                        const chipsHtml = [
                            renderChip('fa-clock', item.timeInfo, 'key-time'),
                            renderChip('fa-location-dot', loc),
                            renderChip('fa-user-group', roles, 'key-role')
                        ].filter(Boolean).join('');

                        card.innerHTML = `
                            <div class="plan-header">
                                <div class="plan-title"><i class="fa-solid fa-calendar-check"></i>${item.title}</div>
                                <div class="plan-type">${item.typeInfo}</div>
                            </div>
                            ${chipsHtml ? `<div class="plan-meta">${chipsHtml}</div>` : item.metaText ? `<div class="plan-meta"><span>${item.metaText}</span></div>` : ''}
                            ${item.descText ? `<div class="plan-desc">${item.descText}</div>` : ''}
                        `;

                        store.plans.set(id, {
                            id,
                            title: item.title,
                            kind: item.typeInfo,
                            time: item.timeInfo,
                            location: loc,
                            roles,
                            desc: item.descText,
                            sortTime: item.sortTime
                        });
                        card.addEventListener('click', () => toggleCardSelection('plans', id, card));
                        plansList.appendChild(card);
                    });
                } else {
                    tabPlans.classList.add('hidden');
                }

                // 3. 渲染活动灵感
                const tabIdeas = document.getElementById('tabIdeas');
                const ideasList = document.getElementById('ideasList');
                const rawIdeas = sections.activity || sections.ideas || '';
                if (rawIdeas.trim() !== '') {
                    hasExtraTabs = true;
                    tabIdeas.classList.remove('hidden');
                    ideasList.innerHTML = '';

                    const parsedActs = rawIdeas
                        .split(REGEX_ACT)
                        .map((b, i) => ({ block: b.trim(), originalIndex: i }))
                        .filter(item => Boolean(item.block))
                        .map(item => {
                            const b = item.block;
                            const headMatch = b.match(/^(.*?)(?:<|＜)(.*?)(?:>|＞)/);
                            const title = headMatch ? headMatch[1].trim() : '未命名活动灵感';
                            const bracket = headMatch ? headMatch[2].trim() : '常规事件';
                            let typeInfo = bracket;
                            let ratingInfo = '';
                            const parts = bracket.split(/\s*(?:⌾|\|)\s*/);
                            if (parts.length > 1) {
                                typeInfo = parts[0];
                                ratingInfo = parts[1];
                            }
                            const metaMatch = b.match(/[├┣]\s*[─-━]\s*(.*?)(?=\n|$)/);
                            const metaText = metaMatch ? metaMatch[1].trim() : '';
                            const descMatch = b.match(/[└┗]\s*[─-━]\s*(?:🎬|📝|📰)?\s*(.*)$/s);
                            const descText = descMatch ? descMatch[1].trim() : '';
                            const actTime = extractMetaField(metaText, '🕒', '🕒|📍|👥');
                            return {
                                title,
                                typeInfo,
                                ratingInfo,
                                metaText,
                                descText,
                                actTime,
                                sortTime: findFirstTimestamp(actTime, ratingInfo, typeInfo, metaText, descText, b),
                                originalIndex: item.originalIndex
                            };
                        });

                    sortCardsByTime(parsedActs).forEach((item, idx) => {
                        const card = document.createElement('div');
                        const id = `activity-${idx}`;
                        card.className = 'activity-card';
                        card.style.animationDelay = `${idx * 0.05}s`;

                        const loc = extractMetaField(item.metaText, '📍', '🕒|📍|👥');
                        const roles = extractMetaField(item.metaText, '👥', '🕒|📍|👥');
                        const chipsHtml = [
                            renderChip('fa-clock', item.actTime, 'key-time'),
                            renderChip('fa-location-dot', loc),
                            renderChip('fa-user-group', roles, 'key-role')
                        ].filter(Boolean).join('');

                        card.innerHTML = `
                            <div class="activity-header">
                                <div class="activity-title"><i class="fa-solid fa-wand-magic-sparkles"></i>${item.title}</div>
                                <div class="badge-group">
                                    <div class="activity-type plot-tag">${item.typeInfo}</div>
                                    ${item.ratingInfo ? `<div class="activity-rating">${item.ratingInfo}</div>` : ''}
                                </div>
                            </div>
                            ${chipsHtml ? `<div class="activity-meta">${chipsHtml}</div>` : item.metaText ? `<div class="activity-meta"><span>${item.metaText}</span></div>` : ''}
                            ${item.descText ? `<div class="activity-desc">${item.descText}</div>` : ''}
                        `;

                        store.activities.set(id, {
                            id,
                            title: item.title,
                            kind: item.typeInfo,
                            rating: item.ratingInfo,
                            time: item.actTime,
                            location: loc,
                            roles,
                            desc: item.descText,
                            sortTime: item.sortTime
                        });
                        card.addEventListener('click', () => toggleCardSelection('activities', id, card));
                        ideasList.appendChild(card);
                    });
                } else {
                    tabIdeas.classList.add('hidden');
                }

                // 4. 渲染平行事件
                const tabEvents = document.getElementById('tabEvents');
                const eventsList = document.getElementById('eventsList');
                const rawEvents = sections.parallel || sections.events || '';
                if (!rawEvents.trim() || rawEvents.includes('无平行事件')) {
                    tabEvents.classList.add('hidden');
                } else {
                    const parsedEvents = rawEvents
                        .split(REGEX_PAR)
                        .map((b, i) => ({ block: b.trim(), originalIndex: i }))
                        .filter(item => Boolean(item.block) && !item.block.includes('无平行事件'))
                        .map(item => {
                            const b = item.block;
                            const headMatch = b.match(/^(.*?)(?:<|＜)(.*?)(?:>|＞)/);
                            const title = headMatch ? headMatch[1].trim() : '无名平行事件';
                            const bracket = headMatch ? headMatch[2].trim() : '未知时间 ⌾ 未知地点';
                            let timeInfo = bracket;
                            let locInfo = '';
                            const parts = bracket.split(/\s*(?:⌾|\|)\s*/);
                            if (parts.length > 1) {
                                timeInfo = parts[0];
                                locInfo = parts[1];
                            }
                            const metaMatch = b.match(/[├┣]\s*[─-━]\s*(.*?)(?=\n|$)/);
                            const metaText = metaMatch ? metaMatch[1].trim() : '';
                            const descMatch = b.match(/[└┗]\s*[─-━]\s*(?:🎬|📝|📰)?\s*(.*)$/s);
                            const descText = descMatch ? descMatch[1].trim() : '';
                            return {
                                title,
                                timeInfo,
                                locInfo,
                                metaText,
                                descText,
                                sortTime: findFirstTimestamp(timeInfo, metaText, descText, b),
                                originalIndex: item.originalIndex
                            };
                        });

                    if (parsedEvents.length > 0) {
                        hasExtraTabs = true;
                        tabEvents.classList.remove('hidden');
                        eventsList.innerHTML = '';

                        sortCardsByTime(parsedEvents).forEach((item, idx) => {
                            const card = document.createElement('div');
                            const id = `parallel-${idx}`;
                            card.className = 'activity-card';
                            card.style.animationDelay = `${idx * 0.05}s`;

                            const roles = extractMetaField(item.metaText, '👥', '👥');
                            card.innerHTML = `
                                <div class="activity-header">
                                    <div class="activity-title"><i class="fa-solid fa-clock-rotate-left"></i>${item.title}</div>
                                    <div class="badge-group">
                                        <div class="activity-type">${item.timeInfo}</div>
                                        ${item.locInfo ? `<div class="activity-type plot-tag"><i class="fa-solid fa-location-dot"></i>${item.locInfo}</div>` : ''}
                                    </div>
                                </div>
                                ${item.metaText ? `<div class="activity-meta"><span>${item.metaText}</span></div>` : ''}
                                ${item.descText ? `<div class="activity-desc">${item.descText}</div>` : ''}
                            `;

                            store.parallels.set(id, {
                                id,
                                title: item.title,
                                time: item.timeInfo,
                                location: item.locInfo,
                                roles,
                                desc: item.descText,
                                sortTime: item.sortTime
                            });
                            card.addEventListener('click', () => toggleCardSelection('parallels', id, card));
                            eventsList.appendChild(card);
                        });
                    } else {
                        tabEvents.classList.add('hidden');
                    }
                }

                const tabsArea = document.getElementById('tabsArea');
                tabsArea.classList.toggle('visible', hasExtraTabs);
            }

            // 更新确认按钮文本与显隐
            function updateConfirmButton() {
                const cOpt = state.selected.size;
                const cPlan = state.selectedPlans.size;
                const cAct = state.selectedActivities.size;
                const cPar = state.selectedParallels.size;

                if (cOpt + cPlan + cAct + cPar > 0) {
                    btnSubmit.classList.add('visible');
                    const summary = [];
                    if (cOpt) summary.push(`选项${cOpt}`);
                    if (cPlan) summary.push(`待办${cPlan}`);
                    if (cAct) summary.push(`活动${cAct}`);
                    if (cPar) summary.push(`平行${cPar}`);
                    btnSubmit.textContent = `确认 (${summary.join(' | ')})`;
                } else {
                    btnSubmit.classList.remove('visible');
                }
            }

            function showToast(msg) {
                toast.textContent = msg;
                toast.classList.remove('show');
                void toast.offsetWidth;
                toast.classList.add('show');
            }

            function applyFontSize() {
                document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--ui-base-size', `${state.fontSize}px`);
                localStorage.setItem(KEY_FONT, String(state.fontSize));
            }

            function checkAutoTheme() {
                if (state.themeMode !== 'auto') return;
                const hr = new Date().getHours();
                state.isDark = hr < 6 || hr >= 18;
            }

            function applyThemeUI() {
                if (state.isDark) {
                    document.body.classList.add('dark-mode');
                    btnManual.textContent = '🦋 枯蝶';
                } else {
                    document.body.classList.remove('dark-mode');
                    btnManual.textContent = '🪼 水母';
                }

                if (state.themeMode === 'auto') {
                    btnAuto.classList.add('active');
                    btnManual.classList.add('dimmed');
                } else {
                    btnAuto.classList.remove('active');
                    btnManual.classList.remove('dimmed');
                }
            }

            function applyCollapseUI() {
                mainPanel.classList.toggle('collapsed', state.isCollapsed);
            }

            // 将文本填入酒馆主输入框
            function setTavernInput(text) {
                try {
                    const textarea = window.top?.document.querySelector('#send_textarea');
                    if (textarea) {
                        textarea.value = text;
                        textarea.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
                        showToast( text ? '已填入输入框' : '输入框已清空' );
                        return;
                    }
                    if (typeof triggerSlash === 'function') {
                        const escaped = text.replace(/(\\+)?([|{}])/g, (m, s, c) => (s || '') + (s || '') + '\\' + c);
                        triggerSlash(`/setinput ${escaped}`);
                        showToast( text ? '已填入输入框' : '输入框已清空' );
                        return;
                    }
                    showToast('未找到输入框');
                } catch (err) {
                    console.error(err);
                    showToast('访问受限');
                }
            }

            // 初始化绑定
            parseAndRender();

            // 标签页切换绑定
            document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn').forEach(btn => {
                btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                    if (btn.classList.contains('hidden')) return;
                    document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
                    btn.classList.add('active');
                    document.querySelectorAll('.list-area').forEach(area => area.classList.remove('active'));
                    const targetId = btn.getAttribute('data-target');
                    const targetEl = document.getElementById(targetId);
                    if (targetEl) targetEl.classList.add('active');
                });
            });

            // 读取本地状态偏好
            const savedFont = localStorage.getItem(KEY_FONT);
            if (savedFont) state.fontSize = Number.parseInt(savedFont, 10) || 16;
            applyFontSize();

            const savedMode = localStorage.getItem(KEY_MODE);
            const savedTheme = localStorage.getItem(KEY_THEME);
            if (savedMode === 'auto' || savedMode === 'manual') state.themeMode = savedMode;
            if (state.themeMode === 'manual' && savedTheme) {
                state.isDark = savedTheme === 'dark';
            } else {
                checkAutoTheme();
            }
            applyThemeUI();

            state.isCollapsed = localStorage.getItem(KEY_COLLAPSE) === 'true';
            applyCollapseUI();

            // 头部点击折叠
            headerToggle.addEventListener('click', () => {
                state.isCollapsed = !state.isCollapsed;
                applyCollapseUI();
                localStorage.setItem(KEY_COLLAPSE, String(state.isCollapsed));
            });

            // 字号加减
            document.getElementById('btnFontUp').addEventListener('click', () => {
                state.fontSize = Math.min(24, state.fontSize + 1);
                applyFontSize();
                showToast(`字体大小: ${state.fontSize}px`);
            });

            document.getElementById('btnFontDown').addEventListener('click', () => {
                state.fontSize = Math.max(12, state.fontSize - 1);
                applyFontSize();
                showToast(`字体大小: ${state.fontSize}px`);
            });

            // 自动模式切换
            btnAuto.addEventListener('click', () => {
                state.themeMode = 'auto';
                localStorage.setItem(KEY_MODE, 'auto');
                checkAutoTheme();
                applyThemeUI();
                showToast('已切换为自动模式');
            });

            // 手动水母/枯蝶切换
            btnManual.addEventListener('click', () => {
                state.themeMode = 'manual';
                localStorage.setItem(KEY_MODE, 'manual');
                state.isDark = !state.isDark;
                localStorage.setItem(KEY_THEME, state.isDark ? 'dark' : 'light');
                applyThemeUI();
                showToast(state.isDark ? '已切换为夜间枯蝶模式' : '已切换为日间水母模式');
            });

            // 重置选择
            document.getElementById('btnRefresh').addEventListener('click', () => {
                state.selected.clear();
                state.selectedPlans.clear();
                state.selectedActivities.clear();
                state.selectedParallels.clear();
                document.querySelectorAll('.option-btn, .plan-card, .activity-card').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('selected'));
                updateConfirmButton();
                showToast('选项已重置');
            });

            // 清空输入框
            document.getElementById('btnClear').addEventListener('click', () => {
                setTavernInput('');
            });

            // 确认填入输入框
            btnSubmit.addEventListener('click', () => {
                const blocks = [];
                if (state.selected.size > 0) {
                    blocks.push(Array.from(state.selected).join('\n'));
                }
                const selPlans = Array.from(state.selectedPlans).map(id => store.plans.get(id)).filter(Boolean);
                const selActs = Array.from(state.selectedActivities).map(id => store.activities.get(id)).filter(Boolean);
                const selPars = Array.from(state.selectedParallels).map(id => store.parallels.get(id)).filter(Boolean);

                const pBlock = formatPromptBlock('plans', sortSelectedItems(selPlans));
                const aBlock = formatPromptBlock('activities', sortSelectedItems(selActs));
                const eBlock = formatPromptBlock('parallels', sortSelectedItems(selPars));

                if (pBlock) blocks.push(pBlock);
                if (aBlock) blocks.push(aBlock);
                if (eBlock) blocks.push(eBlock);

                const finalOutput = blocks.join('\n\n').trim();
                if (finalOutput) setTavernInput(finalOutput);
            });

            // 定时巡检自动模式
            setInterval(() => {
                if (state.themeMode === 'auto') {
                    const prev = state.isDark;
                    checkAutoTheme();
                    if (prev !== state.isDark) applyThemeUI();
                }
            }, 60000);
        });
    </script>
</body>
</html>
